sections.heading: Deposits
body: Deposits are non-refundable once fabric has been cut, as cutting is done specifically to your measurements. If you cancel before cutting begins, your deposit is refunded in full minus a 10% administrative fee.

sections.heading: Fit Corrections
body: Any fit issue identified at your final fitting, or within 14 days of collection, will be corrected free of charge.
Requests for style changes unrelated to fit — a different sleeve length, added pockets, and similar — are treated as a new alteration and quoted separately.

sections.heading: Ready-to-Wear & Shop Items
body: Unworn, unaltered ready-to-wear pieces purchased through our shop may be returned within 7 days of purchase for store credit. Custom-sized or altered shop items are final sale.

seo.title: Refund Policy
seo.description: Our policy on deposits, fit corrections and returns at Lipek Fashion.
